host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-data decision_links 2>&1
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib governed 2>&1
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cli -p athena-data --no-fail-fast --quiet 2>&1

cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --lib decisions --quiet 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p xtask --test policy --quiet 2>&1; ls crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs && cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test mirrors --quiet 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus --quiet 2>&1
cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-core --quiet --no-fail-fast 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: date && wc -l crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs docs/decision-links.toml && git status --short | head

grep -n "pub fn ls_tree_under\|pub fn cat_blob\|pub fn show_file\|pub fn ls_tree" -B6 -A22 crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs | head -150; grep -n "pub fn blob\|pub struct DiffEntry" -A12 crates/athena-git/src/*.rs | head -60
cargo fmt --all 2>&1 | tail -5; cargo test --locked -p athena-data decision_links 2>&1 | tail -40

cat > /tmp/gen_links.py <<'EOF'
import re,sys
src=open('docs/decision-links.toml').read()
head_end=src.index('# D11\'s "Revised')
body=src[head_end:]
body=re.sub(r'line = \d+\n','',body)
# merge duplicates
blocks=re.split(r'\n(?=\[\[|# )',body)
out=[]
seen=set()
text=body
# remove the second D46/D79 and D87/D88 entries
dup=['[[link]]\nolder = "D46"\nnewer = "D79"\nstatus = "superseded"\n\n','[[link]]\nolder = "D87"\nnewer = "D88"\nstatus = "amended"\n\n']
for d in dup:
    first=text.index(d)
    second=text.index(d,first+len(d))
    text=text[:second]+text[second+len(d):]
open('/tmp/body.toml','w').write(text)
EOF
echo skip
git show HEAD:docs/decisions.md | wc -l && ls docs
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib governed 2>&1 | grep -v "^   Compiling" | head -120
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cli -p athena-data 2>&1 | tail -n 60
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cli -p athena-data 2>&1 | rg "FAILED|failed|panicked|test result|error"
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cli -p athena-data --no-fail-fast 2>&1 | awk '/FAILED|failed|panicked|test result|^error/'
git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff docs/decisions.md | head -12
